shot.title: El dominio sigue abierto
shot.visual: Very wide environmental view deeper inside connected paper caves: ONE small chestnut HORSE in strict SIDE PROFILE resting on a far ochre ledge, no humans. THE HORSE MUST BE AS FLAT AS A HAND-CUT PAPER SHADOW PUPPET: a single broad unshaded MATTE CHESTNUT paper torso silhouette with visible thin edge, four slender separately overlapped BLACK-LOWER-LEG paper strips, black mane of a few flat sawtooth cuts, black cut-paper tail, tiny incised eye, ears cut from two thin triangles. No muscular volumes, photographic coat, fur, highlights, skin, nostril modeling, leather or realistic toy horse. Body all one flat even color, not mottled shading. Horse at most12% canvas height, all four legs supported on ledge. Ground layers descend into a large natural passage and return toward another distant warm opening. Broad charcoal and ochre paper sheets, spaced depth planes and cast shadows visible throughout. No additional animals, fairy lights, minerals, palace, furniture or new magic; full bleed inside world, not model base.
shot.transition_to_next: Corte al siguiente episodio, permitiendo salto temporal explícito de la VO.
